note: Committed to the repository BEFORE 03_backtest.py was first executed. All thresholds are project-defined research design choices, not official NFL values.

validation.purpose: select one strategy threshold per strategy

holdout.purpose: scored exactly once with the frozen configuration

pricing_assumption.spread_and_total: -110 on both sides (decimal 1.9090909), used ONLY because no official price archive exists
pricing_assumption.status: ASSUMED, NOT ARCHIVED. This assumption is the reason gate G7 fails for every betting strategy.
pricing_assumption.parlay: 2-leg payout = product of the two leg decimals; no same-game correlation repricing is applied to cross-game parlays (cross-game legs are independent by construction)

gates.name: Provenance & integrity
gates.rule: Every input row carries an official URL or a cited archive; the 2026 score subset must reconcile 160/160 cells to nfl.com standings.

gates.name: Minimum sample
gates.rule: >= 300 settled holdout bets spanning >= 3 distinct seasons.

gates.name: Positive net ROI
gates.rule: Holdout ROI > 0 after vig at the stated price assumption.

gates.name: Luck removed
gates.rule: Week-clustered bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND matched-random permutation p < 0.05 AND Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q < 0.05 within the tested strategy family.

gates.name: Robustness
gates.rule: Positive ROI in >= 60% of holdout seasons AND no single season supplies > 50% of total profit.

gates.name: No look-ahead
gates.rule: Perturbation test: replacing every result after cut-point T leaves every prediction before T bit-identical.

gates.name: Pricing realism
gates.rule: Stakes must be settled at prices from an official/authoritative odds archive. No official NFL odds source exists; every strategy therefore fails G7 permanently.

gates.name: Forward replication
gates.rule: Prospective timestamped record for >= 1 full season. Cannot be satisfied inside a single session.

tiers.Bronze: G1, G2, G6, G7 pass; G3 or G4 fails (edge indistinguishable from luck)
tiers.Rejected: G3 fails (negative edge) or G1/G6 fails
tiers.Research-only: G7 fails (pricing not archived) regardless of ROI
tiers.Blocked: A required official input does not exist; the value is left blank

reward_policy.type: non-monetary research points; no money, prizes or wagering is offered
reward_policy.betting_allocation: split equally among strategies reaching Gold
reward_policy.forecast_allocation: 600/300/100 to the top 3 forecast-skill strategies; forecast skill is price-independent and therefore rewardable even though G7 blocks betting ROI
reward_policy.note: If no strategy reaches Gold, 0 betting points are awarded and the pool rolls over to the next assessment.

strategies_registered.rule: Bet the side where (pred_margin + spread_line) points away from the market by >= theta. theta in {1.0, 2.0, 3.0}.
Bet over when pred_total - total_line >= theta, under when <= -theta. theta in {1.5, 2.5, 3.5}.
Two S1 legs from DIFFERENT games in the SAME week; payout = product of the two leg decimals. Requires both legs S1-qualified at the selected theta.
Bet the home team ATS whenever it is not the favourite (spread_line >= 0). Placebo control, no model input.
Bet the home team ATS whenever it is the favourite (spread_line < 0). Placebo control, no model input.

prop_note: S3 (prop singles) and S7 (prop combos) are NOT registered as betting strategies in this session because no 2026 player-level feed and no archived prop prices exist. Player-prop combo research is published as a correlation study (07_props.py) with zero claimed prices.

baselines: naive: home team by 2.0 points, total = league mean
forecast_skill_leaderboard.rewardable: yes - depends only on archived results and archived closing lines, not on any odds price
